votes.motion: Bring all 4 by-law categories discussed to Counsel (as amended by Brett).

budget_items.topic: FY23 Capital Plan and Engineering lines
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Rob was in favor of leaving the Capital Plan and Engineering figures at the amounts discussed; any unspent amount would go back into Retained Earnings.

budget_items.topic: FY23 deficit under 3% and 8% rate increases
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The deficit would be $404K with a 3% increase and would decrease to $353,900 with the 8% increase.
budget_items.quote: barb noted the deficit would be $404k with a 3% increase and would decrease to $353,900 with the 8% increase.

budget_items.topic: Sewer rate and per-quarter bill effect of 8% increase
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The rate would rise from the current figure to a new figure per 100 cubic feet, and the increase would be about a stated amount per quarter for each ratepayer.
budget_items.quote: the current rate of $12.65 per 100cf would increase to $13.66.
